b1-34-01.title: Communicative Challenge: My Opinion of the Plan
b1-34-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether the plan for the new project is a good one. You (Meg) say that you think it is good, because it is cheap.
b1-34-01.prompt: Tell Károly what you think of the plan and why.
cues: Say that you think the plan is good
Give your reason
b1-34-01.target: Azt gondolom, hogy a terv jó, mert olcsó.
b1-34-01.english: I think that the plan is good, because it is cheap.
b1-34-01.canDo: I can give an opinion and a reason with azt gondolom, hogy … mert ….

b1-34-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of the Flat
b1-34-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks about the new flat. You (Meg) say that on the one hand it is expensive, on the other hand it is big.
b1-34-02.prompt: Tell Petra both sides of the new flat.
cues: Say one thing about the price
Say the other thing about the size
b1-34-02.target: A lakás egyrészt drága, másrészt viszont nagy.
b1-34-02.english: On the one hand the flat is expensive, on the other hand it is big.
b1-34-02.canDo: I can balance competing perspectives using egyrészt... másrészt...

b1-34-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Tired but Helping
b1-34-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg to help with the work tomorrow. You (Meg) say that although you are tired, you will still help.
b1-34-03.prompt: Tell Károly that you will help although you are tired.
cues: Admit that you are tired
Say that you will help anyway
b1-34-03.english: Although I am tired, I will still help.
b1-34-03.canDo: I can concede points gracefully using bár... mégis and jóllehet.

b1-34-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Plan Is Not Expensive
b1-34-04.scenario: Petra says that the plan is too expensive. You (Meg) say that this claim does not hold water and that the plan is undoubtedly cheap.
b1-34-04.prompt: Answer Petra: reject her claim and say what is certain.
cues: Say that the claim does not hold water
Say with certainty what the plan is
b1-34-04.target: Nem állja meg a helyét az állítás, hogy drága a terv. Kétségkívül olcsó.
b1-34-04.english: The claim that the plan is expensive does not hold water. It is undoubtedly cheap.
b1-34-04.canDo: I can rebut ungrounded claims using nem állja meg a helyét.

b1-34-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Meeting
b1-34-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg to sum up the meeting. You (Meg) say that all things considered the plan is good, and that in your view a compromise is important.
b1-34-05.prompt: Sum up the meeting for Károly and give your view.
cues: Sum up the plan in one sentence
Say what you think is important
b1-34-05.target: Mindent egybevetve jó a terv. Meglátásom szerint fontos a kompromisszum.
b1-34-05.english: All things considered, the plan is good. In my view, a compromise is important.
b1-34-05.canDo: I can sum up a discussion with mindent egybevetve and a fentiek tükrében.

b1-34-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Balanced Answer
b1-34-consolidation.scenario: Petra suggests a compromise about the meeting time. You (Meg) say that you partly agree but have a reservation, and that in your view a compromise is important.
b1-34-consolidation.prompt: Answer Petra with a balanced opinion.
cues: Say that you agree in part and name a reservation
Say what you think is important
b1-34-consolidation.target: Részben egyetértek, de van egy fenntartásom. Meglátásom szerint fontos a kompromisszum.
b1-34-consolidation.english: I partly agree, but I have a reservation. In my view, a compromise is important.
b1-34-consolidation.canDo: I can give a balanced opinion that agrees in part and names a reservation.

b1-35-01.title: Communicative Challenge: If I Had Known
b1-35-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why she did not come to the party. You (Meg) say that if you had known about it, you would have come.
b1-35-01.prompt: Tell Petra why you were not at the party.
cues: Say what you did not know
Say what you would have done
b1-35-01.english: If I had known, I would have come.
b1-35-01.canDo: I can form past counterfactual conditions using past tense verbs plus volna.

b1-35-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Better Hungarian
b1-35-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg why her Hungarian is not better. You (Meg) say that if you had practised more back then, you would speak Hungarian better now.
b1-35-02.prompt: Tell Károly what would be different now.
cues: Say what you did not do back then
Say what would be better today
b1-35-02.target: Ha akkor többet gyakoroltam volna, most jobban beszélnék magyarul.
b1-35-02.english: If I had practised more back then, I would speak Hungarian better now.
b1-35-02.canDo: I can link a past condition to a present result: ha akkor … volna, most … lennék.

b1-35-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Test
b1-35-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the test went. You (Meg) say that you should have studied more.
b1-35-03.prompt: Tell Petra what you should have done for the test.
cues: Say what you should have done
b1-35-03.canDo: I can express unfulfilled past obligations using kellett volna.

b1-35-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The News
b1-35-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg how Károly reacted to the news. You (Meg) say that he behaved as if nothing had happened.
cues: Say how he behaved
Say what it looked like
b1-35-04.target: Úgy viselkedett, mintha semmi sem történt volna.
b1-35-04.english: He behaved as if nothing had happened.
b1-35-04.canDo: I can draw hypothetical comparisons using mintha... volna.

b1-35-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking Back on the Trip
b1-35-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether the trip to Hungary was a good decision. You (Meg) say that, thinking back, the trip was useful.
b1-35-05.prompt: Tell Károly what you think about the trip now.
cues: Say that you are looking back
Say how the trip was
b1-35-05.target: Utólag visszagondolva hasznos volt az út.
b1-35-05.english: Looking back, the trip was useful.
b1-35-05.canDo: I can articulate retrospective life evaluations using utólag visszagondolva.

b1-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: If Only I Had
b1-35-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the test went. You (Meg) say that you wish you had studied more, and that you should have set off in time.
b1-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what you wish and what you should have done.
cues: Say what you wish you had done
Say what you should have done
b1-35-consolidation.target: Bárcsak többet tanultam volna! Időben kellett volna indulnom.
b1-35-consolidation.english: If only I had studied more! I should have set off in time.
b1-35-consolidation.canDo: I can use bárcsak … volna and kellett volna to talk about the past.
